summary: Gitea is a self-hosted software development service that combines Git repositories, code review tools, and team collaboration spaces into a single platform. It also includes package registries and continuous integration capabilities to handle the complete application lifecycle. Written in Go, it functions as a lightweight alternative to larger platforms like GitHub or GitLab.
goodFor: Teams and individuals who want a complete, self-hosted code management and collaboration platform without the resource demands of heavier enterprise alternatives.
watchOut: It requires significant ongoing management for upgrades, backups, and user access control, and it overlaps heavily with more established self-hosted Git solutions.
deployNotes: Deployment typically involves setting up persistent storage for your repository data, configuring a separate database such as PostgreSQL or MySQL, and placing the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
